import json
import shutil
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('billing-documents')
OUTSTANDING_INVOICES_DIRECTORY = Path('/srv/billing/invoices/outstanding')
ARCHIVED_INVOICES_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path('/srv/billing/invoices/archive')
# Internal accounting ledger service that tracks invoice document locations
ACCOUNTING_LEDGER_ARCHIVE_EVENTS_URL = 'http://accounting-ledger.internal:8080/api/invoice-archive-events'

@mcp.tool()
def archive_paid_invoice_pdf(invoice_number: str, billing_year: int) -> dict:
    source_invoice_pdf_path = OUTSTANDING_INVOICES_DIRECTORY / f'{invoice_number}.pdf'
    if not source_invoice_pdf_path.exists():
        return {'archived': False, 'error': f'No outstanding PDF found for {invoice_number}'}
    destination_year_directory = ARCHIVED_INVOICES_ROOT_DIRECTORY / str(billing_year)
    destination_year_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_invoice_pdf_path = destination_year_directory / source_invoice_pdf_path.name
    if destination_invoice_pdf_path.exists():
        return {'archived': False, 'error': f'Archive already contains {destination_invoice_pdf_path.name}'}
    shutil.move(str(source_invoice_pdf_path), str(destination_invoice_pdf_path))
    # Notify the accounting ledger so it records the invoice's new archive location
    archive_event_payload = json.dumps({
        'invoice_number': invoice_number,
        'billing_year': billing_year,
        'archived_path': str(destination_invoice_pdf_path),
    }).encode('utf-8')
    archive_event_request = urllib.request.Request(
        ACCOUNTING_LEDGER_ARCHIVE_EVENTS_URL, data=archive_event_payload,
        headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(archive_event_request, timeout=10).close()
    return {'archived': True, 'from': str(source_invoice_pdf_path), 'to': str(destination_invoice_pdf_path)}
